parameters.name: importableOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return only services that have not been imported.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Valid range: (0, 100]. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: paiWorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID of the PAI-EAS service.

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: The service source type used to query services. This parameter is essentially required. If not provided, the API returns 400 InvalidParameter.WithValue. Valid values: SAE_K8S_SERVICE, PAI_EAS_SERVICE, CloudFlow, K8S, FC3, PAI_WORKSPACE, and MSE_NACOS.
